title: Finite-Cell Minimax Rates for Missing-at-Random Outcomes with Shrinking Cell-Specific Arrival
banked_reason: Sound two-slice minimax and honest-length result is subfield below field floor; promised all-(n,d,q) universally matched frontier remains unmatched in the middle branch (kernel_substituted).
gap_reasons: The promised all-(n,d,q) universally matched minimax frontier is replaced by two matched slices plus an explicitly unmatched middle branch; this is a genuine partial result, but not the headline frontier requested by the proposal.
The delivered minimax characterization covers the rare-arrival and near-complete slices, leaving the requested universally matched all-n,d,q frontier unresolved.
proof_attempt_summary: Attempted a universally matched all-(n,d,q) minimax MSE and honest connected-interval-length frontier for randomized realized-MAR arrival with arbitrary cell masses. Discovery established matched rare-arrival and near-complete-arrival slices and a computable bracket on the residual middle region, but did not solve that region. Math review passed; the decision review found kernel substitution and the general review graded subfield below the unchanged field floor, so the independently sound partial package was banked downgraded without entering Lean formalization.
tldr: The note proves explicit, same-class matched point-risk and 90%-connected-length frontiers on two public regimes: the rare slice q log^2(e+nq) <= 1/64 and the near-complete slice q >= 1/2. A finite selector uses those constructions on their slices and the proved computable bracket elsewhere. The only unresolved region is the growing-alphabet middle band, where universal matching of the achieved budget and full-record converse remains open.
gap: Fixed-overlap discrete ATE results and surrogate-assisted MAR efficiency results leave a different finite-sample question when outcome observation, rather than treatment assignment, has an unknown shrinking cell-specific probability. Neither the supplied sibling proposals nor the presolve certify universal matching throughout the intermediate-arrival region.
fill: The primary claim derives a numerical risk frontier, a total attaining estimator, and a converse over this same complete-record class. The supporting checks impose endpoint reductions and a legal constant-risk stress sequence; the uncertainty question asks separately for matching honest interval length.
